summary: Mitsubishi Motors Australia Limited (MMAL) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mitsubishi Motors Corporation of Japan, headquartered in Adelaide's Tonsley Park area with branch offices in several Australian cities. The company was founded in 1980 and manufactured vehicles in Australia after taking over Chrysler Australia's facilities. Australian production ended in 2008, after which MMAL became solely a vehicle importer, with spare parts facilities in Adelaide and Sydney.
one_line: Overview of Mitsubishi Motors Australia Limited, the Australian subsidiary of Mitsubishi Motors Corporation, covering its headquarters, history and shift from manufacturing to importing.
key_facts: Mitsubishi Motors Australia Limited (MMAL) is a fully owned subsidiary of parent company Mitsubishi Motors Corporation of Japan.
MMAL's Australian administrative headquarters are located in the Adelaide suburb of Tonsley Park (Clovelly Park, South Australia).
MMAL has branch offices in Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne and Perth.
Mitsubishi Motors Australia was established in 1980.
Mitsubishi Motors Australia began vehicle manufacturing in 1980.
Mitsubishi Motors Australia took over the facilities of Chrysler Australia.
Australian vehicle production by Mitsubishi Motors Australia ceased in 2008.
Since 2008, Mitsubishi Motors Australia has been exclusively a vehicle importer.
MMAL spare parts facilities are located in Adelaide and Sydney.
